title: Frozen Waterfall That Never Melts

scenes.text: 5 m waterfall that stays solid all year
Iceberg Lake sits at 1,800 m in Glacier National Park, Montana.
scenes.query2: Glacier National Park lake from above

scenes.text: Winter temps drop below –20 °C, freezing the 5‑meter cascade into ice.
The water never thaws because underground springs keep the flow constant and the ice is insulated by a layer of fallen glacier ice.
Follow if you love to travel from your screen.

description: High in Montana’s Glacier National Park, Iceberg Lake hosts a 5‑meter waterfall that never melts. Discover the hidden spring that keeps the ice solid all year.
